paras: Upgrade your Subaru BRZ or Toyota 86 GTS 's rear braking performance with DIXCEL brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to circuit and trackday use.

This listing covers the DIXCEL brake rotor types shown for the Subaru BRZ (ZC6) 2012-2021 and BRZ (ZD8) 2022 onwards, along with the Toyota 86 GTS (ZN6) 2012-2021. All rotors for this application are 290x18mm vented and fit the upgraded GTS-spec rear brake setup. Multiple rotor types are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the rotor type best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
hl: Hole Pattern: 5+2+1 (5-stud with 2 location holes and 1 sensor hole)
